pose: A tactical hunting scene. In the sunlit meadow of the middle ground, a peaceful herd of several small juvenile sauropods are grazing together, completely unaware of their surroundings. In the immediate foreground, the larger feathered dinosaur crouches low behind a dense screen of fern foliage, its body silhouetted by the leaves. Only its large, intensely focused expressive eyes and a calculating, clever smirk break through the greenery as it stalks the herd.
